description: Canonical declarative Zod schemas, TypeScript interfaces, and Neon Prisma data models

documents.title: Data Model 00: Overview & Database Architecture
documents.summary: Defines the database topology (Neon PostgreSQL via Prisma ORM), core data invariants, legacy schema supersession rules, and the deprecation policy.

documents.title: Data Model 01: Universal RFQ Submission & Cart Schema Contracts
documents.summary: Defines the canonical declarative Zod schemas, TypeScript types, and Prisma relational models for Universal RFQ multi-item cart submissions and notification jobs.

documents.title: Data Model 02: Auth.js v5 Session & User Authorization Schema
documents.summary: Defines the TypeScript contracts, Zod schemas, and Prisma models for Auth.js v5 user authentication, OAuth accounts, sessions, and client project scope filters.

documents.title: Data Model 03: Sanity CMS Content Schemas & GROQ Bindings
documents.summary: Defines the Sanity.io headless CMS schemas for products, certifications, portfolio showcases, and spoke configurations, including GROQ query contracts and ISR revalidation patterns.
